note: The public summary of where this tool is going. The working backlog is dilas-roadmap.md in the repo root: everything still open, and what each item waits on. This file is the short version for the person using the tool, so keep every entry to one sentence and update it when the working document moves.

solo.label: Needs nothing new
solo.note: Runs in your browser with no account, no server and no network call.

social.label: Needs the server
social.note: Needs the tool's server, because it passes things between browsers.

milestones.title: The tool itself
milestones.say: Tier lists for all six slots, your collection, the loadout builder and Drop Bay. Everything kept in this browser.

milestones.title: Thirteen themes
milestones.say: 3 base themes and 10 skins, each with its own look behind the panels.

milestones.title: A second opinion, for where you are dropping
milestones.say: Set the front, planet and mission, and every row gets a second tier for your scenario beside the community tier, with the reasons.

milestones.title: Enemy armour
milestones.say: What your armour penetration opens on each front, measured against every body part of 80 enemies.

milestones.title: Difficulty
milestones.say: Ratings count only the enemies you meet at your difficulty.

milestones.title: The last judgement calls
milestones.say: A few traits no source records, like which support weapons are long range, set by hand for now.

milestones.title: Scoring a whole build
milestones.say: Every build gets two tiers: its gear for your scenario, and the build as a whole. Armour penetration counts here.

milestones.title: Drop Bay becomes the drop screen
milestones.say: The mission brief, your loadout and your squad's, and warnings about what is missing.

milestones.title: Live party
milestones.say: Open a party, share its code, and see your squadmates' loadouts as they drop. No account needed.

milestones.title: The galaxy map
milestones.say: Set where you are dropping on the galaxy map, coloured by the live war, with the Major Order and each difficulty's details.

milestones.title: The Star Map
milestones.say: The galaxy map for following the war: every front, each planet's details and history, and one click to drop there.

milestones.title: Drop Bay is the front door
milestones.say: The tool opens on Drop Bay, which suggests your best builds for the drop and lets you edit them in place.

milestones.title: The Armoury
milestones.say: Your saved builds, and a coverage view of what you have for each situation on each front.

milestones.title: The rules, out in the open
milestones.say: Every rule behind the second tier, what it changes for your scenario, and a switch to turn it off.

milestones.title: Commando missions
milestones.say: Commando missions rated for how they play: 12 reinforcements, stratagems twice at most, and weapons that need no ammo ranked high.

milestones.title: Share a build
milestones.say: Share a build as a link. No account needed.

milestones.title: Try this for a change
milestones.say: After a few drops, Drop Bay suggests builds you have not used lately and good gear you have never tried on that front.

milestones.title: The ground, the clock and every armour set
milestones.say: Rules for terrain, mission time limits and megacities, and every armour set with its art and weight.

milestones.title: Numbers from the game itself
milestones.say: Weapon figures and loudness for 105 weapons come from the game's own files, with the wiki filling the rest.

milestones.title: Difficulty and squad size on every front
milestones.say: Anti-tank and crowd clear count for more at high difficulty or with fewer players, on all three fronts, and more of the armoury has rules.

milestones.title: New curated builds
milestones.say: Every preset build replaced with a new set, made from the tool's own ratings and rules.

milestones.title: Planet effects in the ratings
milestones.say: Live planet effects, like strains and surges, changing what the tool suggests.

milestones.title: Accounts
milestones.say: Sign in anywhere and your collection is there. Waits on password reset by email from dilas.me.

milestones.title: Friends and finding a group
milestones.say: A friends list for party invites, and a board for finding a group. Comes with accounts.

milestones.title: Exchange
milestones.say: Browse other players' builds and keep the ones you like.
